answer: The island test I would run is Proof of unique climbing club membership with mountaineering council attestation: a membership the mountaineering council recorded with logged ascents, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the knoll of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out. The dawn is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
